trace: The current MeleeContactAtTimeFacts carries seven metre values as public f32 fields. At resolve_melee_contact_at_time, invalid_contact_cause rejects non-finite or negative facts and nonpositive reach, while actual measure beyond reach becomes a separate invalidation. The derived result retains raw metre values and fractions; the preferred-measure helper also takes and returns f32.

The strategic autoresolve exchange obtains measures and equipment dimensions and calls the same resolver. The tactical server independently obtains current surface distance, reach and equipment dimensions and calls it at attack completion. These two code paths motivate a connected owner and boundary review, not persisting tactical state or assuming that all distances have identical sign/zero policies.

The historical contact geometry has SignedLength fields, unlike the current source; its historical form is not restored into, or credited as, the current tree or checkpoint 3821. Current ContactTimingOffset independently admits finite signed time and checks subtraction; signed timing is a separate quantity from geometry.
